spec: Three-pass MST of Lemma 3.5 (B1 = max(2, ceil(log2 L_k)), B2 = L_k from the original k, then B = +inf) whose edge set equals the Kruskal (length, index) MST exactly, whose tree paths realise the minimax walk value for every vertex pair, and whose quotient after each pass stays within 1 + 2l'/B; connected API rejects disconnected input, spanning_forest_three_pass returns the minimum spanning forest; lightest_edge_per_pair keeps the (length, index)-least edge per unordered vertex pair; per-pass sizes recorded in Diagnostics.counters
paper_ref: Sec 3.2, Lemma 3.5 (three passes, bottleneck property), Lemma 3.4 (vertex bound); Alg 4 l.4 (lightest edge per pair)
